lines.t: The Lord raises His voice
Within the hearts of the elect,
Yet silence bears witness
To those who refuse to hear,
A veil of pride is fast held,
Over heads of arrogant souls,
Covering them in darkness’ day,
But grace will not let go.
Grace to the humble, crown of glory,
The way of the elect shines forevermore.
In shadows or silence, faith tells the story,
Grace covers all, grace covers all.
Pride is a veil so tightly held,
Blinding eyes that won’t see,
But those who walk with humble hearts
Wear a light for all to see.
The Lord’s voice calls in quiet power,
Breaking through the darkened veil,
A crown awaits the faithful ones,
Whose grace shall never fail.
Grace to the humble, crown of glory,
The way of the elect shines forevermore.
In shadows or silence, faith tells the story,
Grace covers all, grace covers all.
Hear the silent witness of the Lord,
Calling out through sacred truth,
Where pride would fall, grace stands tall,
In the humble lies the proof.
Grace to the humble, crown of glory,
The way of the elect shines forevermore.
In shadows or silence, faith tells the story,
Grace covers all, grace covers all.
